about_short_description.short_description: EasyPost provides a simple postage API that allows developers to quickly and painlessly integrate shipping into any e-commerce application.

product.name: EasyPost Shipping API
product.description: A RESTful API that integrates shipping functionalities with over 100 carriers, enabling rate shopping, label creation, tracking, and returns management.

product.name: EasyPost Enterprise
product.description: An advanced shipping platform for high-growth shippers offering configurable business rules, parcel visibility, and 24/7 support to simplify complex shipping operations.

product.name: Luma AI-Powered Shipping Solution
product.description: An AI-driven solution that provides real-time shipping insights, smart recommendations, and automated label selection to optimize shipping costs and carrier choice.

product.name: SmartRate API
product.description: An API that uses AI to provide cost and delivery date estimates, enabling users to find better shipping rates.

product.name: Address Verification API
product.description: An API that validates and verifies domestic and international shipping addresses to ensure accurate delivery.

product.name: Tracking API
product.description: An API providing real-time shipment tracking and status updates across over 100 carriers with webhook support for near real-time notifications.
